card.line: Derbe was a small city in Lycaonia where Paul and Barnabas fled from danger, preached the gospel, and made many disciples.

moments.title: Fleeing to Derbe
moments.text: When people in Iconium planned to stone them, Paul and Barnabas fled to the Lycaonian cities of Lystra and Derbe. They kept preaching the gospel there.

moments.title: Many Disciples Made
moments.text: After Paul was stoned in Lystra, he got up and left the next day with Barnabas for Derbe. They preached the gospel to that city and made many disciples.

moments.title: Paul Returns to Derbe
moments.text: Paul came to Derbe and then to Lystra, where he found a disciple named Timothy. Timothy was well spoken of by the brothers, and Paul wanted him to come along.

moments.title: Gaius of Derbe
moments.text: Gaius from Derbe was one of the men who traveled with Paul. They went on ahead and waited for him in Troas.
